plan.title: Start from the rink_game base
plan.contract:
Start from the base: the Foreman copies engine/templates/rink_game/ (the job's ref/base/rink_game/) into the pack whole, as it is: a working game on the rink core (ctx.cores.open("rink", <cartridge>)). No builder runs for this package. Later packages change the game by editing the base's data: the cartridge (data/<name>.cartridge.json), the skin (data/skin.json), an optional rules sidecar (data/<name>.rules.json); a file a later package's scope names is that package's from then on. The base's bots: tests/bot_match_hand.gd, tests/bot_first_match.gd, tests/bot_skin.gd, tests/bot_toys.gd.
PLAYER CHECK: tests/bot_match_hand.gd fails when the human's skater never carried the puck or took no shot

plan.title: Harbour 3 v 3 cartridge
plan.contract:
Write data/harbour.cartridge.json (tj.cartridge/1): copy the base's data/hockey.regular.cartridge.json, set id "harbour-playmakers", title "Harbour Playmakers", and change only the keys below. Nearest thirdjam modes to read: Pond (rink, passing keys) and Arsenal (abilities, pickups, zones) in ref/cores/rink/modes/. data/match.json: cartridge "harbour.cartridge.json", difficulty "rookie". Keep the base's regular cartridge file. No .rules.json sidecar, no core patch.

TEAMS (3 v 3; keep the base's team ids and order). Blue colour_hex #1FB5A8: player (-1.5,0), support (-4,-8), back (-18,0). Orange #E8622C: chaser (1.5,0) = WINCH, support (6,-8) = GULL, back (18,0) = BREAKWATER.

RINK: game.rink.length_m 60, width_m 30, corner_radius_m 3.75, goals the base's. game.rink.zones, exactly 8, these ids (the drawing package relies on them), visible true:
- arrow-a (-10,-9), arrow-b (10,-9), arrow-c (-10,9), arrow-d (10,9): shape rect, w 6, d 3, kind fast_ice, strength 0
- ring-west (-10,0), ring-east (10,0): circle r 3.5, slow_ice, strength 0.7
- spot-north (0,-9), spot-south (0,9): circle r 1, boost_only

game.effects: four effects with id arrow-a..arrow-d: trigger zone_enter, zone = own id, target self, duration_frames 75, stack refresh, stats skater_speed multiply 1.35 and skater_accel multiply 2. Plus id second-wind: trigger director, target own_team, duration_frames 480, stats skater_speed multiply 1.12.

game.pickups: {kind speed, zone spot-north, magnitude 1.1, duration_frames 60} and {kind precision, zone spot-south, magnitude 1.5, duration_frames 120}; both spawn_every_frames 180, max_on_ice 1.

game.abilities, in this order, each cooldown_frames 180: shield (trigger mode, charges 1, duration_frames 240); shield (pickup, charges 1, duration_frames 240); slow_puck (pickup, charges 1, duration_frames 60, magnitude 0.75). D1: you start holding one shield; once spent either spot grants one random pickup entry; none while holding. If the validator or core refuses the three-entry pool or it never grants slow_puck, ship mode shield plus pickup shield only and say so in your report as 'OWNER: shield pickup only'.

game.rules: mode first_to, score_to_win 5, penalties false. hooks: {id tide-turns, when on_goal, team conceding, then [apply_modifier kind second-wind frames 480; announce text "TIDE TURNS"]}; {id match-point, when on_score_reached, team scoring, score.at_least 4, then [announce text "MATCH POINT"]}. At 4-4 the next goal wins by first_to.

OTHER LINES: game.shot.one_timer.window_frames 20; game.stick.reception_m 3; game.skater.pass_lead_frames 20; game.ai.yield_margin_m 0; game.ai.body_check 0.6; game.contact.bot_check_windup_frames 12 (the rival's tell); game.look.tier l2_night, trim_colour_hex #FFA23A; game.camera mode third_person, distance_m 7, height_m 4, look_ahead_m 5, fov_deg 70, lag_frames 4.

FEEL (effective values; keep the base's key or core default, write the key only where the effective value differs): skater speed 11, accel 12, turn_rate 5, carry_speed_mult 0.92, free_speed_mult 1.15; shot.cooldown_frames 24; stick.take_grace_frames 30 (poke grace); contact.momentum true (bump keeps both in control; stumble costs half speed, control, maybe puck, and the attacker pays speed; knockdown downs the victim, attacker slowed); a missed check glides open; a missed poke locks the human's stick; pokes beat the shield; a body shields the puck. All other press frames stay the core's. ai.speed_scale unchanged: difficulty never adds hidden speed; catch-up is only second-wind. Do not set pass_speed.

CHECK AND REPORT (numbers, with the hand that measured them): bash engine/tools/rink.sh check-cartridge data/harbour.cartridge.json. D5: also run it on a scratch copy (outside data/) at length_m 70, width_m 35 and report completed passes and match length for both; ship 60 x 30. Report at rookie any warning, goals a match, match length, knockdowns, passes a minute. D3 tuning allows ring strength 0.5 to 1 and slow_puck magnitude 0.7 to 0.9, and D2 allows body_check up to 1; ship the values above (the later drill measures them, including strength 1.0).

plan.title: Bubble, arrows, slush, spots, harbour drawing
plan.contract:
Presentation-only drawing over the base. Read the core's snapshot() (ref/cores/rink/SNAPSHOT.md); never call a core setter, never move a core body, never change the core hash. main.gd gets only a small hook (setup, tick after the base has posed the figures). Do not touch skating, puck, contact, bot or camera code, and keep rink_toys drawing (bot_toys). Visual shapes: TLBodies.make with {layer 0, mask 0, track false}, pooled, hidden via visible; no materials, no meshes of your own; under 600 bodies. Every number is a key in data/tuning.json under "harbour" (keep any existing keys), read at start. Zone ids come from the cartridge: arrow-a..d, ring-west/east, spot-north (speed), spot-south (precision). Build in this order, flat shapes first; if time runs short cut scenery props, never feel.

1 BUBBLE: while the human's shield is active, three crossed hoops of small cyan beads around the holder, visible within 3 frames of F, active 240 frames from frame 1. Slow puck armed or running: a small glow ring of beads on the puck. On a blocked check, cross-check or lift: beads flare, TLVfx.burst sparks, TLAudio.play("hit_rubber"), both figure poses hold 8 frames, the attacker's visual node recoils 0.4 m away, decaying to exactly 0 over 12 frames. Move the whole figure visual together so nothing detaches; the simulation never freezes. Detect from snapshot events; only if none exist, require centre distance under 0.85 m AND the rival closing or in its check pose while shield is active. Never flare on proximity alone. Unused bubble fades quietly: no burst.

2 HINT AND PROMPT: base HUD hint stays from the skin. Show 'F: BUBBLE NOW' only while the human carries, holds a shield and WINCH (orange chaser) is within prompt_range_m 5 closing over prompt_closing_mps 2.

3 ARROWS: double-headed chevrons over each strip; on a skater entering, flash along the crosser's velocity, TLVfx.trail for 75 frames, burst ice_spray, TLAudio.play("nitro").

4 BLUE ICE: raised slush rim and flecks on both rings; puck entering bursts splash; puck under 6 m/s inside glints and snaps (one short sound per stall).

5 SPOTS: bobbing green buoy when loaded, dim ring when empty. Use snapshot pickup list/events if present; else infer from the 180-frame spawn timer plus skater crossings. On the human's grant a HUD tag at the spot names the trick, 'BUBBLE' or 'SLOW PUCK', 90 frames (from the held ability change). spots.state_mode "inferred" or "plain"; plain = neutral beacons with no loaded state.

6 GULL ROLE GEAR (each distinct in silhouette, follows its figure) and HUD tags: WINCH a back drum with hook, GULL a long beak visor, BREAKWATER wide block shoulders.

7 CONTACT FEEL: figures stay the core's pawn and clips (body_check, cross_check and so on; no TLHit). Pose hold 3 to 8 frames on attacker and victim scaled by force; every press answered within 3 frames; victim flinches, stumbles or falls and attacker slows as the core says; rival tell at least 12 frames. ctx.cameras.shake(0.2, 14) only on the human's knockdown or a goal, nothing on bumps or whiffs (remove or gate other shakes reachable from main.gd; never add a duplicate). Camera numbers are the cartridge's; contacts never move it. Goals keep the base horn, crowd and banner.

8 HARBOUR: after the arena part is built, hide barn, stands, benches, boxes; keep rink surfaces, boards, nets and light. data/harbour_venue.json (tl.layout/1): flat terrain or ground below the ice level, TLKit crane x2, light_mast x4, pond (still water), lumber, tyre_stack, all at least 12 m outside the boards (|x| >= 42 or |z| >= 27).

DRILL BOT tests/bot_harbour.gd: plays through TLHand "regular" using ctx.input only for the pack match: F at the first drop, skates a strip, visits spots, passes, shoots, pokes and checks. PLAYER CHECK: tests/bot_harbour.gd fails when the player's F no longer raises the bubble or the player's skater can no longer reach an arrow strip. ok = bubble drawn within 3 frames of F, an arrow burst by the player, venue hidden, run complete. It reports moments {shield_bounce, slush_trap, arrow_breakaway, shield_up, spot_take} as frame lists (absent events stay empty; get shield_up and arrow within 600 frames) and metrics: feedback_f, prompt_first_f (target <= 900), openings and winch_bubble_by_1800 (target 8 of 10 faceoffs), shield_checks/crosses/lifts, shield_falls and non-poke strips (0), poke_steals, spot_matches/spot_takes (19 of 20, else set plain), slush_entries, stalls under 6 m/s, otter_collects, armed_feeds_received (targets 7 of 10), arrow_speed and slush_speed measured, passes, gull_idle_max_f (<= 120). D3: the bot also opens data/drill_slush100.cartridge.json (the game's cartridge with both rings strength 1.0) and the game cartridge as private bot-run cores (ctx.cores.open), tests 1.0 first, and reports stalls for both. Each missed or unmeasured target goes into the summary as 'OWNER: ...' with the number (including 'no real stall seen'); missed AI targets do not fail ok and are never faked.

plan.title: Harbour Playmakers skin
plan.contract:
Edit data/skin.json (schema tl.rink.skin/1; unknown keys are errors; read scripts/hud/skin.gd for the keys). title "Harbour Playmakers"; tagline "F: bubble. Green spots reload it." (the first-minute hint); team_names "the Tide Otters" for the blue #1FB5A8 side and "the Crane Gulls" for the orange #E8622C side, in the key order skin.gd expects (set team_plural plural if the key applies). Colours come only from the cartridge. HOME's lines speak of a dusk harbour rink, three against three, first to five; level row stays rookie, pro, all_star. Keep the base's end card (score and team names, R rematches within 2 s) and its mouse prompts for shoot, pass, poke and check.

Optional if time allows: data/harbour_commentary.json in the base bank format (scripts/hud/commentary_lines.gd rows), a copy of the builtin lines with a few orange-team lines naming Winch (the chaser, hits hard and straight), Gull (waits for passes) and Breakwater (guards the crease), plus goal cheers and barks; point skin.json at it. Use only events and kinds the bank already supports, and do not claim a skater did something the event cannot know. No line promises a dropped slow field: the blue rings are painted and never move, and the F slow puck crawls then wakes.

events.text:
- RULE: MEGA is drawing only. Any landed body check by any skater sets that skater's MEGA, read from the victim's `ContactOutcome > 0` and `ContactBy`, not a cross-check. That includes a rival checking another rival. A player sees the double-size figure, the white flash, MEGA! and FLATTENED!, but contacts are still decided by the core's normal momentum law.
- NOT DONE: "twice as heavy and a bit faster, every bump knocks a man flat, turns wide" needs `data/harbour.cartridge.json` or its rules sidecar `data/harbour.rules.json`, which are outside my scope. It needs a per-skater modifier that starts on a landed check, about 300 frames long: mass ×2, speed ×1.1, turn rate ×0.6, every contact he makes counted as a knockdown, for bots and the human alike. I found no cartridge key for a modifier that starts on a check. The rules hooks' `apply_modifier` works per team, and I did not check whether there is a check trigger, so the cartridge owner must search CARTRIDGE.md for one or write the sidecar.
- Sounds: there is no boing or pop preset. The boing uses `hit_rubber`, the thud `break` and the pop `beep`. They're named in `harbour.mega` so they can be swapped.
- The centre-screen word says "YOU ARE MEGA!" for the player, following the words rule. Other skaters get "MEGA!" as a tag over them.
- The MEGA scale is applied to the core's figure node, which is drawing only. To stop the size compounding when the base holds a pose, it sets the scale to the figure's own scale before MEGA times the MEGA size each frame, rather than multiplying the current one.
- `tests/bot_harbour.gd` does not report MEGA yet. `harbour.marks` records `mega_on`, `mega_flatten` and `mega_off`, but none of them are in the bot's moments or metrics.
- No NEW MOVE: MEGA adds no attack of its own. It changes how the core's existing body check looks.
- Values added in `harbour.mega`: frames 300, scale 2.0, grow_f 12, shrink_f 10, flat_shake_m 0.08, flat_shake_f 8, tremble_every_f 9, word_f 70. No existing value was changed.
